acceptance_criteria.text: Guidance records exact delegated checkpoint and Help-reference decisions without inventing acceptance, reducing a roadmap, or authorizing deployment/paid activation/trial.

Canonical status and guidance identify current operational receipts, their common-root location, publication-snapshot semantics and the existing clean-staging helper route while preserving dirty root edits.

Reconciliation guidance distinguishes closed fixes from remaining Provider admission/visual gates and later ETF/TC/Strategy contracts and migrations; no stale pointer, collision or coverage failure is represented as current.

Documentation-only scope, YAML/workstream/link/diff checks and normal exact-source CI are recorded honestly; publish the clean source for delegated coordinator review with all product acceptances still open.
